approved_scope.description: Bound transition history and preserve referenced proof
acceptance_criteria: Legacy logs and recorded proof remain byte-identical; explicit adoption writes independent immutable transition events with a cursor in the sole checkpoint; compatible branch events integrate without loss and divergent current-cycle cursors refuse; normal reads and per-cycle storage have tested byte and event limits; timing keeps lineages separate and reports missing or pruned history as partial or unknown; retention previews exact protected and eligible sets and applies only with explicit authorization and fresh protection checks; crash, collision, unsafe-path and interruption fixtures preserve active state; roadmap and backlog mappings distinguish delivered work from open criteria

answers.constraints: Preserve the single schema-2 checkpoint and atomic current-cycle merge group from PR #29; preserve all legacy proof and frozen native archives; keep native gates authoritative and fail closed on unreadable protection sources; reuse existing evidence retention policy without automatic transition deletion; lessons in specs/cli/context.md require bounded fixtures and distinguish observed results from proposed tests; the Kimi cold-start proof remains not run by 0xLeif choice; no implementation, scope approval, review, release or merge is implied by this definition; no model client, runtime, service or duplicate lifecycle state
